title: Alex Eala thrills Pinoy fans in Nagoya with another Asian Games win
summary: Philippines tennis star Alexandra Eala stormed into the Asian Games semi-finals in Japan on Wednesday, cheered on by fans who had come from far and wide to see their hero in action.
